rationale: SLICE iteration 1 for the round-6 chassis. It replaces the round-2 plan, whose 4 perimeters and 25 % fill were below the requirements' 5 and 30 %. Profiles from config/printer.json: stock MK3S printer, 0.20mm QUALITY @MK3, Prusament PETG (filament_type PETG = print_requirements). Its 240 then 250 °C, bed 85 then 90 °C and 30-50 % part fan sit inside the requirements' 230-250 / 80-90 °C and the skill's PETG guidance, so they are not overridden. library/materials.csv and lessons.md are empty: no flow, temperature or xy_size_compensation overrides. Overrides meet print_requirements.json exactly: 5 perimeters (about 2.1 mm a side, so the 4.5 mm walls print nearly solid), 5 top / 5 bottom layers, 30 % gyroid, 0.2 mm layers. Elephant-foot compensation 0.2 is not required here but pairs with the model's bed chamfer. Orientation is in the STL (brief): floor on the bed, walls vertical, 40.0 mm tall (200 layers, on the grid). No supports: mesh_check gives 0.53 % overhang, and the largest bridge is the 8 mm idler-slot hull (DFM PASS). Seam: aligned, chosen by slicing all three placements and counting loop starts on the critical faces. Aligned: 59 starts at the plate seats, almost all in the two back corners of the head-plate recesses (x 108 and 129, |y| 30, Z 10.4-15.2); 2 on the skin's outer face where the motor's thrust washer bears; none in the gearbox pockets. Rear: 47 at the nut-plate end stops and 30 on the skin's washer face. Nearest: 67 at the plate seats and 5 in the gearbox pockets. Aligned leaves the skin washer face and the pockets clean; the preflight says to break the plates' corners when deburring and to scrape any corner bump if a head plate won't sit flush (BUILD_GUIDE §1 step 5 already files tight plates). Brim: none (brim_width 0): 11 540 mm² of flat floor holds a 154 × 92 PETG tub, and a brim would leave a lip on the chamfered bottom edges. 1 copy on 1 plate = spec §7 quantity 1; sliced 11.53 h (11.69 h in silent mode) against the 12 h limit.
